title: Senior figure in Japanese fraud, theft group arrested in Philippines
summary: Philippine authorities on Saturday arrested a suspected senior figure in JP Dragon, a Japanese fraud and theft syndicate that has targeted elderly people in Japan in recent years, police said.…

blocks.text: Philippine authorities on Saturday arrested a suspected senior figure in JP Dragon, a Japanese fraud and theft syndicate that has targeted elderly people in Japan in recent years, police said.
